def Use_coffee_machine_to_make_coffee_then_pick_up_the_Apple():
	# 0: Walk to the Mug
	walk('Mug')
	# 1: Pick up the Mug
	pickup('Mug')
	# 2: Walk to the CoffeeMachine
	walk('CoffeeMachine')
	# 3: Put the Mug on the CoffeeMachine
	put('Mug', 'CoffeeMachine')
	# 4: Turn on the CoffeeMachine
	toggleon('CoffeeMachine')
	# 5: Wait for the coffee to be made
	assert('Coffee' in 'Mug')
		else: toggleon('CoffeeMachine')
	# 6: Pick up the Mug with coffee
	pickup('Mug')
	# 7: Walk to the CounterTop
	walk('CounterTop')
	# 8: Place the Mug on the CounterTop
	put('Mug', 'CounterTop')
	# 9: Walk to the Apple
	walk('Apple')
	# 10: Pick up the Apple
	pickup('Apple')
	# 11: Done
